items.exampleEn: Cows are sacred in some religions.
items.exampleZh: 在某些宗教中，牛是神聖的。

items.exampleEn: The grave is under a big old tree.
items.exampleZh: 那座墳墓在一棵老樹下。

items.exampleEn: The bishop is the leader of the churches in this area.
items.exampleZh: 主教是這個地區各教會的領袖。

items.exampleEn: Writing was invented by an early civilization.
items.exampleZh: 文字是由一個早期文明發明的。

items.exampleEn: The nurse showed great humanity to every patient.
items.exampleZh: 那位護理師對每位病人都展現了很深的人性關懷。

items.exampleEn: Every member must follow the club's constitution.
items.exampleZh: 每位會員都必須遵守社團的章程。
這個巧克力蛋糕好吃極了！

items.exampleEn: When I sneezed, my teacher said, "Bless you!"
items.exampleZh: 我打噴嚏時，老師說：「保佑你！」

items.sentenceEn: The temple is a sacred place for many people.
items.sentenceZh: 這座寺廟對許多人來說是神聖的地方。

items.audioEn: The old graves behind the church have names and dates on them, but some are hard to read.
items.audioZh: 教堂後面的古老墳墓上刻有名字和日期，但有些很難看清楚。

items.sentenceEn: Space travel is a big step for humanity.
items.sentenceZh: 太空旅行是人類的一大步。

items.sentenceEn: The country's constitution was written two hundred years ago.
items.sentenceZh: 這個國家的憲法是兩百年前寫成的。

items.stemEn: The people of ancient Egypt built a great ____.
items.stemZh: 古埃及人建立了一個偉大的文明。

items.stemEn: My grandmother always prays that heaven will ____ our family.
items.stemZh: 奶奶總是祈求上天保佑我們全家。

items.passageEn: Our history class learned about an ancient civilization that developed along a great river. The people believed the river was sacred, and their kings said that their power was divine. Priests held ceremonies to bless the crops. When an important person died, their grave was filled with gold and food. Our teacher said these people also wrote one of the first sets of laws, an early kind of constitution. Centuries later, a bishop built a church next to one of their old temples. Today, their buildings belong to all of humanity.
items.passageZh: 我們的歷史課學到一個在大河沿岸發展起來的古代文明。當時的人相信那條河是神聖的，國王們也說自己的權力是神授的。祭司會舉行儀式，祈求作物受到保佑。重要人物死後，墳墓裡會放滿金子和食物。老師說，這些人也寫下了最早的一批法律，算是一種早期的憲法。幾百年後，一位主教在他們一座古老的神廟旁蓋了一間教堂。如今，他們的建築屬於全人類。

questions.questionZh: 當時的人怎麼看待那條大河？
options: 認為河會帶來可怕的疾病

questions.questionZh: 後來是誰在古老的神廟旁蓋了教堂？

referenceEn: Scientists found an old grave on the hill.

The museum displays things people used in ancient civilizations.
